# Jeweller Studio

> Jeweller Studio is a branding and marketing studio that works only with jewellers. It helps jewellery brands with digital marketing, branding, AI jewellery photoshoots and reels, packaging, commercial printing, exhibition and retail branding, gifting, and websites. Founded by Jigar Shah (Founder) and Nikita Butani (Co-founder), with Neet Shah as Digital Consultant. Address: Discovery Complex, Dattapada, Borivali East, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400066. Contact: WhatsApp +91 90298 72736.

Notes: Service pages describe what we offer and how we work. Pricing and timelines are agreed per project. We do not guarantee specific business results.

## Services (nine areas, 125+ individual services)
- [Digital Marketing overview](https://jewellerstudio.com/digital-marketing/): Digital marketing for jewellery brands: social media management, reels, influencer marketing, Meta Ads, YouTube and WhatsApp marketing, and lead campaigns.
- [Branding overview](https://jewellerstudio.com/branding/): Jewellery branding services: brand strategy, logo design, naming, positioning, brand guidelines, storytelling, rebranding and catalogue design for jewellers.
- [AI Jewellery Photoshoot overview](https://jewellerstudio.com/ai-jewellery-photoshoot/): AI jewellery photoshoots: model, bridal, lifestyle, campaign and e-commerce images, plus background replacement and retouching, created from your designs.
- [AI Jewellery Reels overview](https://jewellerstudio.com/ai-jewellery-reels/): AI jewellery reels and videos: cinematic films, bridal campaign films, 3D animation, macro videos, festival reels, ad videos and voiceovers for jewellers.
- [Packaging & Printing Solutions overview](https://jewellerstudio.com/packaging/): Jewellery packaging: custom boxes for necklaces, bangles, rings, earrings and pendants, plus pouches, trays, gift boxes, carry bags and shipping boxes.
- [Commercial Printing overview](https://jewellerstudio.com/commercial-printing/): Printing for jewellers: visiting cards, catalogues, brochures, certificates, tags, invitations and stationery with foil, Spot UV and embossing finishes.
- [Exhibition & Retail Branding overview](https://jewellerstudio.com/exhibition-retail-branding/): Exhibition stall design, showroom branding, store signage, window displays, hoardings and mall branding for jewellers, with print and video content.
- [Gifting overview](https://jewellerstudio.com/gifting/): Gifting for jewellers: corporate hampers, Diwali gift sets, wedding return gifts, client gifts, silver coin gifts and personalised keepsakes.
- [Website & E-commerce Solutions overview](https://jewellerstudio.com/website-ecommerce/): Jewellery website design, e-commerce development, Shopify and WordPress, landing pages, website content and SEO for jewellers who want to be found online.

## Free tools
- [Free Tools](https://jewellerstudio.com/tools/): Free calculators for jewellers and jewellery buyers
- [Jewellery Price Calculator](https://jewellerstudio.com/tools/jewellery-price-calculator/): Metal value, making charges, GST and total for any jewellery
- [Gold Price Calculator](https://jewellerstudio.com/tools/gold-price-calculator/): Gold jewellery price with purity (24K, 22K, 18K), wastage, making and GST
- [Gifting Budget Calculator](https://jewellerstudio.com/tools/gifting-budget-calculator/): Plan customer, wedding or staff gifts with packaging, GST, spares and a budget check
- [Compare Two Jewellery Quotes](https://jewellerstudio.com/tools/compare-jewellery-quotes/): See which jewellery quote is really cheaper after purity, making charges, wastage and GST
- [Old Gold Exchange Calculator](https://jewellerstudio.com/tools/old-gold-exchange-calculator/): Old gold value with purity, stone weight and deduction

## Guides
- [Blog](https://jewellerstudio.com/blog/): All guides for jewellers and jewellery buyers (new articles are listed here and in the blog sitemap)
- [How Jewellery Price Is Calculated](https://jewellerstudio.com/blog/how-jewellery-price-is-calculated/): Gold rate, making charges, wastage, stones and GST explained with an example
- [What You Get When You Exchange Old Gold](https://jewellerstudio.com/blog/what-you-get-when-you-exchange-old-gold/): How purity, stone weight, rate and deductions set the exchange value
- [How to Compare Two Jeweller Quotes](https://jewellerstudio.com/blog/how-to-compare-two-jeweller-quotes/): Compare rate, making, wastage, stones and GST to find the real total
- [Why Digital Marketing Is Important for Every Jewellery Brand](https://jewellerstudio.com/blog/why-digital-marketing-is-important-for-jewellers/): Why customers research jewellery online first and how to start simply
